name: GPU Voxelization via Compute Shaders
definition: A GPU-based voxelization technique using Direct3D 11 and Shader Model 5.0. It rasterizes 3D geometry into a voxel grid using a two-pass approach: a first pass counts the number of voxels to allocate memory, and a second pass writes the voxel data.
summary: GPU Voxelization via Compute Shaders converts 3D meshes to voxel grids by decoupling intersection logic from rasterization, enabling custom geometric tests and atomic operations for high-throughput volume rendering.
